bias.en: Rebound · MACD crossed up, slipped under $407
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，跌回 $407 下方

read.en: TSMC fell 1.9% on Nov 12 to $405.49, trading $393.91–411.77. It is above the rising 5-day ($395.9), the 10-day ($393.8) and the rising 200-day ($402.8) and below the 30-day ($425.2) and 100-day ($425.7). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($352.50), and RSI is 47.3.
read.zh: 台积电 11月12日下跌 1.9%，收于 $405.49，盘中区间 $393.91–411.77。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$395.9）、10 日均线（$393.8）和上行的 200 日均线（$402.8）上方，30 日（$425.2）和 100 日均线（$425.7）下方。MACD 于 11月12日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$352.50），RSI 为 47.3。

read.en: The close slipped under the $407–410.6 support (Oct 15 and Nov 11 lows, Nov 4 high), now resistance, while the $393.91 low held the 10-day. Resistance is $407–411.8, then $414.8–416.8 and $425–426 (30 and 100-day). Support is $400.2–402.8 (200-day, Nov 10 high), then $393.8–395.9 (10 and 5-day) and $387.2 (Nov 10 low). A close above $411.8 would target $415–417; below $400, $394–396.

r.en: Nov 11 low $407.03; Oct 15 low $407.13; Nov 4 high $410.59, lost; Nov 12 high $411.77
